text: In a small Oregon town, thirteen-year-old Mike watches [the Tall Man|threat|death and fate], the local mortician, lift a heavy coffin back into his hearse instead of burying it. His brother Jody dismisses him until a severed finger, still moving and dripping yellow ichor, turns into a flying insect before Jody and their friend Reggie. Inside the Morningside mausoleum wait [a flying silver sphere|images|weapons and tools], hooded dwarves who were [once the town's dead|threat|the dead that rise], and [a portal to a red, hot world|origin|from another world].
